main.description: A message posted into a namespace. There is no separate channel or room concept -- the namespace a message is written into IS the channel, same as every other record type in this design uses the namespace itself as the scoping unit rather than layering a second structure on top. Append-only by construction: every message gets its own key (minted by the writer, not coordinated with anyone else), so any number of members can post without colliding -- the same shape network.essmesh.governance.proposal/signal and the freeform inbox primitive already use, and the reason this was the first of the batteries-included apps built (ESS_MESH_SPEC.md's app-list section): it needed no new sync primitive at all.

replyTo.description: Stand-in for com.atproto.repo.strongRef until real record referencing exists (same convention network.essmesh.governance.signal's subject field uses) -- '{authorHex}/{rkey}' naming the message this one replies to. Optional; a message with no replyTo is a new top-of-thread message.
